title: Native Implicit Resource Items
objective: Resolve declared indexed operations for constructor-inferred native FFI resources without requiring unused type imports

oracles: IR equivalence for explicit versus constructor-only resource imports
Existing FFI declaration qualification and source provenance checks

handoff.summary: Constructor-inferred FFI resources now use the same declaration-qualified indexed operations as explicitly imported resource types. Annotation visibility and private native import rules are unchanged. Six focused lowering/core-emission tests, eight borrowed-resource/lifetime qualification tests, all 44 FFI tests, and all 15 active compiler fixtures pass (18 historical fixtures skipped). Strict Python checks pass for 247 modules. A fresh 15m35s build rebuilt all 39 production families. Changed-file and architecture gates stop only at the expected stale optimizer evidence fingerprint; that release refresh is integration-owned.
risks: The compiler changes invalidate the optimizer evidence fingerprint: this lane expects input 5702e3174ac387c3e17a7cd27a0f076090435cbe61ed1dac012bc1100a3851fe while the inherited manifest records 517d89c5e2892276c74051d5392f3b0f75367dafe06f8bc70a5cb6a540f3d6c9. Integration must regenerate and publish combined evidence.
Full native and cross-platform qualification is pending; this lane remains active and its PR is draft.
next_steps: Integrate the scoped compiler fix with staged cubic work only after its build is idle, then regenerate source-matched evidence.
Run the combined full-native and cross-platform gates before changing this task from active to review.
